checks.reason: Temporary debug markers must not reach shipped source.
checks.specification:
id: no-debug-markers
kind: forbid-text
reason: Temporary debug markers must not reach shipped source.
scope:
    - src/**/*.js
required: true
compare: strict
text:
    pattern: DEBUG_ONLY

checks.reason: Deployment configuration must name a supported environment.
checks.specification:
id: deployment-environment
kind: document
reason: Deployment configuration must name a supported environment.
scope:
    - deploy/config.json
required: true
compare: strict
document:
    selector: /environment
    allowed-values:
        - staging
        - prod
